verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so neither is the better resize. In both, the pink brush stroke has come away from the headline and sits as two stray streaks at the far left and right edges. The brick photo has shrunk to a thin sliver and the crane photo to a thumbnail that means nothing at this size. The body copy is tiny and hard to read, and most of the banner's width is empty white space, so the original's two-photo structure is lost.
